snippet.title: BULKHEAD Survival (7/12/2013)
snippet.description:
Official description: BULKHEAD Survival is an action packed survival FPS for single player and multiplayer online co-op. How long can you survive against the increasingly skilled AI opponents?

RELEASE DATE: 7/12/2013
DEVELOPER: Raoghard
GENRE: Action & Adventure
Offline players 1
Online multiplayer 2 - 4
Online co-op 2 - 4
